### Picking this up
1. Assign yourself, and move the card to **In progress** on the V1.1 project.
2. `git checkout V1.1 && git pull && git checkout -b feat/<id>-<name>`
3. In Claude Code, run `/pick-task #<this issue number>`.
4. Open a PR into `V1.1` with `Closes #<this issue>`.
